name: agora_interior
description: A covered stoa inside the ancient agora, with sunlit colonnades and tidy market tables ready for stories and play.

color_palette: Warm neutrals: Limestone Beige (#D8C7A2) for walls and columns and Chalk White (#F5F2E8) for limewash trim to keep the space bright and clean.
Earthen accents: Terracotta (#C65D3A) for floor tiles and amphorae to ground the scene and feel cozy and historic.
Details: Cedar Brown (#6E4B3A) for wood beams and benches, Aegean Blue (#2E86AB) for pottery and simple signage to guide the eye.
visual_style.architectural_style: Classical Greek stoa interior with sturdy Doric columns, whitewashed stone surfaces, and an open arcade facing the market. Simple geometric border motifs and painted friezes keep the space calm and orderly.
visual_style.furniture: Low cedar benches in Cedar Brown (#6E4B3A) line the walls beneath the colonnade, leaving a clear central walkway. Chalk White (#F5F2E8) display tables stand in neat rows, with woven baskets in Aegean Blue (#2E86AB) accents gathered near the columns. A small reading mat area marked by Terracotta (#C65D3A) rugs forms a cozy story circle at one end.
materials: Whitewashed limestone block walls with smooth lime plaster finish.
Terracotta floor tiles laid in simple rows for easy sweeping.
Cedar timber beams and rafters supporting the roof.
Bronze lamp stands and fittings for warm, durable details.
